nodes.summary: Let $p$ be a prime and let $F(z) = \exp\big(\sum_{j \ge 0} z^{p^j} / p^j\big) \in \mathbb{Q}[[z]]$ be the Artin–Hasse exponential. For every $n \ge 0$, the coefficient of $z^n$ in $F$, written in lowest terms, has a denominator not divisible by $p$.

nodes.summary: Let $I$ be an ideal of a commutative ring $A$. If $I$ carries a divided-power structure $(\gamma_k)_{k \ge 0}$ in the usual sense, then $I$ is a divided-power ideal: for every $a \in I$ and every $k \ge 1$ there is $c \in I$ with $a^k = k!\, c$.
nodes.title: Ideals with divided powers are divided-power ideals

nodes.summary: In every commutative ring, the zero ideal is a divided-power ideal.
nodes.title: The zero ideal is a divided-power ideal

nodes.summary: Let $p$ be a prime and let $A$ be a commutative ring in which every natural number not divisible by $p$ is a unit (a $\mathbb{Z}_{(p)}$-algebra). An ideal $\mathfrak{a}$ of $A$ is a divided-power ideal if and only if for every $a \in \mathfrak{a}$ there is $c \in \mathfrak{a}$ with $a^p = p\,c$, that is, $a^p \in p\mathfrak{a}$.
nodes.title: The $p$-th power criterion for divided-power ideals

nodes.summary: Let $p$ be a prime and let $O$ be a discrete valuation ring with maximal ideal $\mathfrak{m}$ such that $pO = \mathfrak{m}^e$ for some integer $e \ge 1$. Then $\mathfrak{m}$ is a divided-power ideal if and only if $e \le p - 1$.
nodes.title: When the maximal ideal of a DVR is a divided-power ideal

nodes.summary: Let $p$ be a prime and let $O$ be a discrete valuation ring with maximal ideal $\mathfrak{m}$ such that $pO = \mathfrak{m}^e$ for some integer $e \ge 1$. Then for every $k \ge 0$, the ideal $\mathfrak{m}^k$ is a divided-power ideal if and only if $e \le (p - 1)k$.
nodes.title: Powers of the maximal ideal of a DVR that are divided-power ideals

nodes.summary: Let $p$ be a prime and $A$ a commutative ring in which every natural number not divisible by $p$ is a unit (a $\mathbb{Z}_{(p)}$-algebra). For a subset $S \subseteq A$, the ideal $\mathfrak{a}$ generated by $S$ is a divided-power ideal if and only if for every $a \in S$ there is $c \in \mathfrak{a}$ with $a^p = pc$, that is, $a^p \in p\mathfrak{a}$.

nodes.summary: An ideal $I$ of a commutative ring $A$ is a *divided-power ideal* when for every $a \in I$ and every integer $k \ge 1$ there is $c \in I$ with $a^k = k! \, c$, that is, $a^k \in k! \, I$. For a prime $p$, in a torsion-free $\mathbb{Z}_{(p)}$-algebra this says $a^k / k! \in I$.

nodes.summary: For every natural number $p$ and every integer $u \ge 1$, the multiset consisting of $p$ copies of $u$ is a $p$-splitting of the one-element multiset $\{pu\}$.
nodes.title: $p$ copies of $u$ form a $p$-splitting of $\{pu\}$

nodes.summary: Let $p$ be a natural number and $s$, $t$ multisets of natural numbers (multisets of parts). Then $s$ is a *$p$-splitting* of $t$ when there is $u \ge 1$ such that $t$ contains the part $pu$ and $s$ is obtained from $t$ by removing one instance of $pu$ and adding $p$ copies of $u$.
nodes.title: $p$-splitting of multisets of parts

nodes.summary: Let $A$ be a commutative ring. If $\mathfrak{a}$ is a divided-power ideal of $A$, then for every ideal $\mathfrak{b}$ of $A$ the product $\mathfrak{a}\mathfrak{b}$ is a divided-power ideal.

nodes.summary: Let $p$ be a prime, $v_p$ the $p$-adic valuation, and $\mathfrak{b}$ an ideal of a commutative ring $B$. The following are equivalent: for every $n \ge 1$ and every $a \in \mathfrak{b}$ there is $c \in \mathfrak{b}$ with $a^n = p^{v_p(n!)} c$; and for every $a \in \mathfrak{b}$ there is $c \in \mathfrak{b}$ with $a^p = p c$.
nodes.title: A prime-exponent criterion for powers in an ideal

nodes.summary: Let $p$ be a prime, let $A$ be a commutative ring in which every natural number not divisible by $p$ is a unit (a $\mathbb{Z}_{(p)}$-algebra), and let $\mathfrak{a}$ be a divided-power ideal of $A$. If $x, y \in A$ satisfy $x - y \in \mathfrak{a}$, then for every $m \ge 0$ there is $c \in \mathfrak{a}$ with $x^{p^m} - y^{p^m} = p^m c$, and for every $n \ge 0$ there is $c \in \mathfrak{a}$ with $x^n - y^n = n c$.

nodes.summary: Let $p$ be a prime, $\mu$ the Möbius function and $n \ge 1$. The sum of $\mu(d)$ over the divisors $d$ of $n$ with $p \nmid d$ is $1$ if $n$ is a power of $p$ (including $n = 1 = p^0$) and $0$ otherwise.

can_prove.label: ready to prove
can_prove.meaning: Statement is in Lean and nothing it needs is blocked, so the proof can start.

can_state.label: ready to state
can_state.meaning: Everything its statement uses is in Lean, so the statement can be written in Lean.

conditional.label: conditionally proved
conditional.meaning: Proof compiles, but rests on an open statement without a recorded Lean proof.

fully_proved.label: fully proved
fully_proved.meaning: Proved, and every prerequisite is fully proved too.

inventory_checked.label: inventory checked
inventory_checked.meaning: Module inventory checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

inventory_pending.label: inventory pending
inventory_pending.meaning: Module inventory not yet checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

not_ready.label: not ready
not_ready.meaning: Needs more blueprint work before it can be attempted.

proved.label: proved
proved.meaning: Proof compiles, but something it rests on is not finished.

stated.label: statement formalized
stated.meaning: Statement is in Lean; the proof is not.
